newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE opens steady as ICI soars.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE opens steady as ICI soars.

text.p: The UK stock market reversed modest early pre-market losses on Thursday as chemicals giant ICI soared after it released third-quarter results.

The FTSE 100, which had eased early on after Wall Street's lower close, was up 4.3 points at 4,032.7 as official trading got underway. Dealers said the market was underpinned by steady gilts and the firm overnight performance from Treasuries.

ICI dominated early dealing, confounding market expectations with a firm 17-1/2p rise to 793p after the group announced third-quarter results at the lower end of forecasts. Over 1.2 million shares had changed hands by 0745 GMT.
